entries.symptom: Ad error handling breaks after an AdMob library update
entries.cause: Legacy error code strings are deprecated (removed in v18)
entries.fix: Branch on error.phase, then error.reason

entries.symptom: The banner never appears
entries.cause: Offline, Premium, consent not given (canRequestAds false), ads switched off for the variant, no fill, or a container that renders nothing until the ad loads
entries.fix: Check the ad policy inputs in the debug menu and open the Ad Inspector in a preview build; always mount the banner slot (it keeps zero height until an ad loads) and never wrap it in a container that renders nothing until the ad is visible

entries.symptom: canRequestAds stays false
entries.cause: The user refused consent where that blocks ads
entries.fix: Expected; the privacy-choices row lets them change it

entries.symptom: Ad error reason ad-already-used
entries.cause: A full-screen ad object was shown twice
entries.fix: Use each ad object once and destroy it after CLOSED

entries.symptom: The first interstitial or rewarded ad after launch never loads
entries.cause: The ad was preloaded before initialize() had resolved
entries.fix: Await initialize (after consent) before any preload

entries.symptom: An interstitial covers a result or summary screen
entries.cause: The call sits in the screen effect instead of the button handler that leaves the screen
entries.fix: Only the handlers that navigate away (Next, Continue) show an interstitial, through the ad policy

entries.symptom: A banner test passes undefined as the size
entries.cause: The mock lacked BannerAdSize.LARGE_ANCHORED_ADAPTIVE_BANNER (ANCHORED_ADAPTIVE_BANNER is deprecated)
entries.fix: The root mock lists both sizes

entries.symptom: An ads-off build contacts Google's consent service at launch
entries.cause: The consent port was built for the ads SDK directly, ignoring the ads mode
entries.fix: Build it through the consent factory with the ads mode; ads are enabled only when the mode is not off

entries.symptom: No consent form appears in the EEA on a real device
entries.cause: No published GDPR message in the AdMob console, or a cached answer
entries.fix: Human step: the developer publishes the message; in preview builds use the debug geography EEA plus AdsConsent.reset()

entries.symptom: Consent debug settings are reachable in a production build
entries.cause: debugGeography and AdsConsent.reset() were not behind the test-only gate
entries.fix: Reach them only through test-only code; unit-test the gate

entries.symptom: The consent update fails offline, and no ads show later although consent was given
entries.cause: The UMP request needs the network
entries.fix: Use canRequestAds from the earlier session when the update fails; the ad policy suppresses ads while offline

entries.symptom: The App Tracking Transparency prompt is missing before the first ad request, or the app has no NSUserTrackingUsageDescription
entries.cause: The expo-tracking-transparency plugin entry is missing, or the consent flow never asks, or code outside the consent adapter asks in the wrong order
entries.fix: On iOS ask in this order before any ad request: Google's form when required, then the ATT prompt while the status is not determined and the app is active. Add ['expo-tracking-transparency', { userTrackingPermission }] to the plugins and import the package only in src/services/consent/expo-tracking-consent-adapter.ts. A child-directed app has neither

entries.symptom: The app crashes when it asks for tracking: "This app has crashed because it attempted to access privacy-sensitive data without a usage description ... NSUserTrackingUsageDescription"
entries.cause: requestTrackingPermissionsAsync ran in a build whose Info.plist has no usage string (plugin entry missing, or the native project predates it)
entries.fix: Add the expo-tracking-transparency plugin entry with a translated userTrackingPermission, prebuild with --clean and rebuild
match: privacy-sensitive data without a usage description

entries.symptom: The ATT prompt never appears (requestTracking returns at once), or the tracking question shows twice with a Google explainer before it
entries.cause: iOS shows the prompt only while the app is active; a device that restricts tracking answers at once; the user already answered (once per install); Maestro's launchApp granted it; or an IDFA explainer message is published in the AdMob console, so UMP runs its own ATT flow first
entries.fix: Ask after the consent form closes and AppState is active; publish no IDFA explainer in AdMob; to see the prompt again delete the app from your own simulator and reinstall. Declined, restricted and unavailable are normal answers: ads still serve without the IDFA

entries.symptom: Apple's tracking alert appears while Google's consent form is still drawn behind it
entries.cause: The consent flow asks right after the form reports closed; the form's dismissal is still on screen when iOS presents the alert
entries.fix: Nothing to fix: the order is right. Only an ATT alert before the form is answered is a bug

entries.symptom: Google's "Our app wants to stay free for you" page appears before Apple's tracking prompt in a preview build outside the EEA
entries.cause: Preview builds use Google's sample AdMob app id, and that sample app publishes an IDFA explainer message
entries.fix: Expected in builds with the sample id only; never publish an explainer in the real AdMob app if the app shows its own flow
match: Our app wants to stay free for you

entries.symptom: App Review rejection risk under guideline 5.1.2(i): the ads SDK declares tracking (Device ID) in its privacy manifest
entries.cause: Google Mobile Ads' own manifest declares Device ID used for tracking
entries.fix: Ask for ATT before any ad request on iOS, answer App Privacy with Device ID collected and used for tracking by the third-party SDK, and keep the app's own manifest honest (NSPrivacyTracking false when the app's code tracks nothing)

entries.symptom: Apple emails about missing required-reason APIs
entries.cause: Apple does not reliably parse the privacy manifests of static CocoaPods
entries.fix: Aggregate every pod manifest into ios.privacyManifests; the privacy audit fails on a gap

entries.symptom: The App Privacy questionnaire or the Play Data safety form cannot be filled by the agent
entries.cause: Both are console forms
entries.fix: Human step: the developer fills them from the privacy contract and the audit output

entries.symptom: The runtime socket audit sees WebKit or system-daemon traffic
entries.cause: Ads render in a web view whose traffic comes from a system networking process; store traffic goes through a system daemon
entries.fix: Run the runtime audit with ads off; store traffic is expected

entries.symptom: @react-native-community/netinfo makes HTTP requests to clients3.google.com
entries.cause: Its default reachability check fetches generate_204 whenever the native layer gives no answer
entries.fix: Detect connectivity with expo-network behind the ConnectivityPort, or configure NetInfo without the reachability probe; an offline-only app declares neither

entries.symptom: const send = globalThis.fetch passes lint and the bundle audit
entries.cause: The rules matched only direct calls of the network globals
entries.fix: Never alias network globals; network goes through the ApiClient port

entries.symptom: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription and NSBonjourServices appear in the generated Info.plist of every variant
entries.cause: expo-dev-client's plugin adds them to the generated plist
entries.fix: Expected on SDK 57: its build phase strips them from every non-Debug product, and the dev-launcher pods are Debug-only; check the Release .app, not the generated plist

entries.symptom: aps-environment is development in a production build
entries.cause: expo-notifications writes aps-environment: development unless its mode says otherwise
entries.fix: Set the plugin's mode to production for production builds (per variant)

entries.symptom: SKTestSession in a UI-test runner does not control the app; products stay []
entries.cause: The UI-test runner is a separate process; xcodebuild test ignores the scheme StoreKit configuration
entries.fix: A hosted XCTest bundle (TEST_HOST = the app) arms StoreKit testing for the bundle id; then launch the app normally

entries.symptom: StoreKit testing fails silently
entries.cause: The app was built without the get-task-allow entitlement
entries.fix: Debug-only get-task-allow for the StoreKit test build; the release gate proves it absent

entries.symptom: Premium disappears right after a purchase
entries.cause: A just-bought purchase is briefly missing from the current entitlements, and a foreground re-check fires after the sheet closes
entries.fix: Revoke only on a verified transaction with a revocation date; absence keeps the cached state

entries.symptom: restorePurchases throws sync-error
entries.cause: AppStore.sync failed or the account prompt was cancelled
entries.fix: Map it to a 'could not restore' state, never 'nothing to restore'

entries.symptom: The price never loads, with no error
entries.cause: fetchProducts returns [] silently when the store cannot resolve the product id
entries.fix: Map an empty result to 'store unavailable'; check the product id and its state in the store console

entries.symptom: The purchase screen shows a price while the phone is offline
entries.cause: Nothing linked connectivity to the store flow
entries.fix: Wrap the purchase port with connectivity and reload the store on reconnect

entries.symptom: A refund is not applied after a launch that started offline: Premium stays on when the phone comes back online
entries.cause: The launch re-check ran offline, where a missing entitlement is not evidence, and nothing re-checked on reconnect
entries.fix: Re-check entitlements when connectivity returns and on every foreground while online

entries.symptom: Premium might be revoked or missing when entitlements are read offline
entries.cause: Not verified whether the current entitlements are complete offline
entries.fix: An error keeps the cached state; only a verified revocation removes it

entries.symptom: A refund in the test store does not reach the running app
entries.cause: The test store did not push an update; only the launch re-check saw the revocation
entries.fix: Handle both paths (the transaction listener and the launch check)

entries.symptom: Family Sharing for a non-consumable: should it be on?
entries.cause: Turning Family Sharing on in App Store Connect cannot be undone
entries.fix: A product decision for the developer; keep the StoreKit configuration and the console in agreement, and never turn it on without that decision

entries.symptom: The app's music starts over the user's own music
entries.cause: The audio library has no API for "other audio is playing"
entries.fix: Keep background music off by default (or read the session's secondaryAudioShouldBeSilencedHint in a small native module); use the ambient category

entries.symptom: The next sounds are dropped after a fast sequence of events
entries.cause: Cancelled cues kept their voice slots, and cues scheduled out of order got a negative time gap
entries.fix: Model voices as intervals on the audio clock and release them on cancel

entries.symptom: A click in the middle of a synthesised sound
entries.cause: A layer that starts after 0 has no fade-in
entries.fix: Give every late-starting layer a fade-in of at least 1 ms

entries.symptom: No sound on a device build although the audio plugin options are defined
entries.cause: The plugin constant is never added to the plugins list of app.config.ts
entries.fix: Add the audio library's plugin entry, prebuild with --clean

entries.symptom: Haptics do not change with an audio session option such as iosAllowHaptics
entries.cause: The option only affects recording sessions
entries.fix: Leave it at its default with the ambient category

entries.symptom: Haptics cannot be felt in the simulator or emulator
entries.cause: Simulators have no haptic engine
entries.fix: Check haptics on a device; the adapter test only proves the calls

entries.symptom: Haptics calls end in .catch(() => undefined), which looks like a swallowed error
entries.cause: Expo documents haptics as a no-op that can reject in Low Power Mode and similar states
entries.fix: Keep it as the one allowed fallback inside the haptics adapter; everywhere else errors are recorded

entries.symptom: A volume slider sits at full and the setting holds fractions like 0.8
entries.cause: The slider works in 0 to 1 while the settings row passed 0 to 100
entries.fix: Convert percent and fraction in one place (the row) and save only when the whole percent changes

entries.symptom: null in expo.extra arrives as {} on the device
entries.cause: Expo serialises extra through the manifest
entries.fix: Omit keys instead of writing null
